programme.title: Dirt
programme.desc: The best way to learn is by doing, especially in Hawaiʻi. Teaming up with locals like Chef Mark "Gooch" Noguchi, Nathan Florence, and Jack Johnson, the DIRT crew dove headfirst into the rugged microclimates and deep-rooted cultures that define the islands. Charging waves, tracking invasive Axis deer, and diving for dinner gave Josh and the gang a visceral education in what makes this archipelago so singular. The hard work and good times culminated in a final feast as complex and generous as Hawaiʻi itself.

programme.desc: In this episode of The Wilderness Chronicles, we uncover true accounts from around the world that feel almost impossible. Two kayakers are lifted from the water by something massive lurking just below the surface of the ocean. - These are not legends. And are these modern encounters more than just coincidence?
